description: This file contains functions related to MAC address retrieval, manipulation, and decoding from various sources such as device tree, mounted memory partitions, MMC, and configuration files, specifically tailored for embedded devices within the OpenWrt ecosystem.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC data from a given partition file at a specified offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from /etc/board.json configuration.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Attempts to get MAC address from device tree first, then from JSON config.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds character device path for given MTD partition name.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts and canonicalizes a MAC address string from a textual partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from an MTD partition by its name.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from a specific encrypted MTD partition using either uencrypt or openssl.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from a partition using DES-ECB.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI config UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address as text directly from a partition at a given offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC address data from a UBI volume identified via UCI.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Returns size of an MTD partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from MMC.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address (used for OUI or NIC modifications).

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the SD card CID checksum.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the LAN bit in MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address based on random data.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Sanitizes and standardizes a MAC address string into canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.
